# Field

A label, control, hint and error laid out together, the same way every time.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Content first</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Content first:** Lays out the newsletter and search forms.

- **Use it when:** Every form control that needs a label, a hint or an error.
- **Not when:** A control that is not part of a form, such as a search box in a toolbar.

Instead:

- [Label](./label.md): The label on its own.

## How Content first uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">Field label or column header</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> type.label</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> type.caption</div></div><div class="cap">Caption is too faint for a label people must read.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">An error message</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> color.status.danger and a plain sentence</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> Color alone</div></div><div class="cap">The sentence says what to fix; color only draws the eye.</div></div></div>

## Why it works this way

Field looks the way it does because of 4 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Field, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-people-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What accessibility level do we commit to?</b><code>people.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">AA</div><p>AA is the commitment for a public site.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Field</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>vertical</b>: Newsletter and search forms: the label above.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: focus</code> <code>Button: disabled</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Field decision would reopen</small><p>and 3 answers that follow from it: <b>A ratio, line heights in proportion</b>, <b>Two: color and word</b>, <b>AA</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-tasks-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How often do people repeat actions?</b><code>tasks.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Rarely</div><p>Actions are rare: subscribe, share, save.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Field</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>horizontal</b>: Forms are rare and short; stacking keeps the reading column.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: primary</code> <code>Button: large</code> <code>Input group: block-start</code> <code>Input group: block-end</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Field decision would reopen</small><p>and 2 answers that follow from it: <b>Three</b>, <b>Only what today's screens use</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-human-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What must the interface protect?</b><code>human.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Attention on the content</div><p>Attention belongs to the text.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Field</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>horizontal</b>: Forms are rare and short; stacking keeps the reading column.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: large</code> <code>Empty: default</code> <code>Item: muted</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Field decision would reopen</small><p>and 8 answers that follow from it: <b>Surface, text, action and status</b>, <b>Only what floats</b>, <b>One</b>, and 5 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-scenarios-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>Where do people use it?</b><code>scenarios.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Anywhere, on any device</div><p>Readers arrive on phones and laptops alike.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Field</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>responsive</b>: One stacked layout reads the same on phones and laptops.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Field decision would reopen</small><p>and 4 answers that follow from it: <b>Light and dark</b>, <b>Touch size</b>, <b>Two</b>, and 1 more.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The label, hint and error are linked to the control, so they are read with it. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add field
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
